name: Hollow Body Hold
steps: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your legs straight together and your arms extended straight overhead alongside your ears.
Press your lower back firmly flat against the floor by bracing your abs tightly.
Lift your shoulder blades and straight legs a few inches off the ground so your body forms a shallow, rigid dish shape.
Hold the tension steadily while breathing smoothly for the target duration, then relax down onto the floor.
tips: Raise your legs slightly higher or tuck one knee if your lower back begins to peel off the floor.
Keep your chin slightly tucked so your neck stays comfortable without straining forward.
